g.text: Kutup - Object diagram: the library on Friday 16 October 2026.
Baran Yıldız owes a $15.00 damage fee for a copy of Emma he returned torn. He asks to borrow Hamlet;
lending.checkCheckout() refuses: unpaid fines over the $5.00 limit.
message = "The member owes more in fines than the policy allows."
so the loan is refused. A librarian could still
override it with a written note (overridable = true).
